touristGuide.title: Denver Union Station
touristGuide.text: Denver Union Station is a lively downtown landmark with a restored historic facade, local shops, and easy connections across the city. On a clear day, look west for the Rocky Mountains.

hotspots.translation: trem leve urbano
hotspots.example: We took the light rail from Union Station to the airport.

hotspots.translation: molho de pimenta verde
hotspots.example: Could I get my breakfast burrito smothered in green chile?

hotspots.translation: início de uma trilha
hotspots.example: Let's meet at the trailhead before the morning hike.

mission.title: Find the Airport Train
mission.description: Você está na Union Station e precisa confirmar de onde sai o trem para o aeroporto.

steps.npcLine: Are you looking for the train to Denver International Airport?

options.text: Yes, please. Which platform does the A Line leave from?
options.feedback: Boa! 'Which platform...?' pergunta em qual plataforma embarcar; o A Line conecta Denver ao aeroporto.

options.text: Yes, where is the train for go airport?
options.feedback: A ideia foi entendida, mas em inglês dizemos 'the train to the airport'. Para perguntar a plataforma, use 'Which platform...?'

touristGuide.title: French Quarter
touristGuide.text: The French Quarter is known for its iron balconies, Creole architecture, and lively music. The historic neighborhood is best explored on foot, with a streetcar ride nearby offering another classic way to see New Orleans.

hotspots.translation: bonde
hotspots.example: We caught the St. Charles streetcar for a ride through the Garden District.

hotspots.translation: doce frito coberto com açúcar
hotspots.example: Let's share a plate of beignets with our coffee.

hotspots.translation: desfile musical tradicional de Nova Orleans
hotspots.example: The brass band led a joyful second line through the neighborhood.

mission.title: Catch the Garden District Streetcar
mission.description: Você quer confirmar se está no ponto certo para pegar o bonde até o Garden District.

steps.npcLine: Are you waiting for the streetcar to the Garden District?

options.text: Yes. Is this the stop for the St. Charles line?
options.feedback: Muito bem! 'Is this the stop for...?' é uma forma natural de confirmar se você está no ponto certo.

options.text: Yes. This place is where the streetcar goes?
options.feedback: A frase soa pouco natural. Para confirmar um ponto, pergunte 'Is this the stop for...?' e nomeie a linha.

touristGuide.title: Roosevelt Row
touristGuide.text: Roosevelt Row is a walkable arts district in downtown Phoenix, filled with murals, galleries, and independent businesses. The desert light is bright, so visitors often plan outdoor walks for the cooler morning or evening.

hotspots.translation: período de chuvas intensas de verão
hotspots.example: Monsoon storms can bring sudden rain and dust to the Valley.

hotspots.translation: saguaro, cacto típico do deserto de Sonora
hotspots.example: We spotted a tall saguaro beside the desert trail.

hotspots.translation: alerta de calor intenso
hotspots.example: The heat advisory recommends drinking water and limiting midday outdoor activity.

mission.title: Plan a Desert Garden Visit
mission.description: Está muito quente em Phoenix; peça uma orientação segura para visitar o jardim botânico.

steps.npcLine: The Desert Botanical Garden is open today. Do you need directions?

options.text: Yes, please. What's the best way to get there, and is there a shaded place to wait?
options.feedback: Ótimo! Você pediu direções e perguntou por sombra. Em Phoenix, planejar pausas e se proteger do calor é importante.

options.text: Yes, I want go there in the hot now.
options.feedback: Use 'I want to go' ou, com mais naturalidade, peça orientação: 'What's the best way to get there?' Evite sair no calor sem planejamento.

touristGuide.title: Centennial Olympic Park
touristGuide.text: Built for the 1996 Olympic Games, Centennial Olympic Park sits in the heart of downtown Atlanta. Museums, the Georgia Aquarium, and major venues are all within an easy walk of the park.

hotspots.translation: sistema de transporte público de Atlanta
hotspots.example: We took MARTA from the airport to downtown Atlanta.

hotspots.translation: sobremesa assada de pêssego com cobertura
hotspots.example: The restaurant serves warm peach cobbler with vanilla ice cream.

hotspots.translation: parque urbano conhecido de Atlanta
hotspots.example: We rented bikes and rode through Piedmont Park on Saturday.

mission.title: Take MARTA to Midtown
mission.description: Você está no centro e quer chegar a Midtown usando o transporte público de Atlanta.

steps.npcLine: Are you trying to get to Midtown from here?

options.text: Yes. Which train should I take, and where do I transfer?
options.feedback: Excelente! Você perguntou qual trem pegar e onde fazer a baldeação. 'Transfer' é uma palavra comum em instruções de transporte.

options.text: Yes, what train I take for go Midtown?
options.feedback: Em perguntas, use 'Which train should I take?' e diga 'to Midtown', não 'for go Midtown'.

touristGuide.title: Lower Broadway
touristGuide.text: Lower Broadway is one of Nashville's best-known music districts, with live bands playing in venues throughout the day and night. Visitors can also explore the Ryman Auditorium, a historic stage closely tied to the city's music story.

hotspots.translation: frango frito apimentado ao estilo de Nashville
hotspots.example: Could I get the hot chicken with the spice on the side?

hotspots.translation: bar com música country ao vivo
hotspots.example: We heard a country band playing at a honky-tonk on Broadway.

hotspots.translation: apresentação em que compositores se revezam contando e cantando suas músicas
hotspots.example: At the songwriter round, each musician shared the story behind a song.

mission.title: Order Nashville Hot Chicken
mission.description: Em uma lanchonete local, pergunte sobre o nível de pimenta antes de fazer seu pedido.

steps.npcLine: How hot would you like your chicken: mild, medium, or hot?

options.text: Medium, please. Could I get the sauce on the side?
options.feedback: Boa escolha! 'Could I get...?' é um pedido educado, e 'on the side' significa servido à parte.

options.text: I want medium hot, put sauce separate.
options.feedback: Para soar mais natural, peça 'Medium, please' e diga 'Could I get the sauce on the side?'

touristGuide.title: Reading Terminal Market
touristGuide.text: Reading Terminal Market has served Philadelphia since the nineteenth century. Its busy aisles bring together local produce, baked goods, and neighborhood favorites, including the city's famous sandwiches.

hotspots.translation: sanduíche comprido típico da região
hotspots.example: I'll have an Italian hoagie with everything on it.

hotspots.translation: sistema de transporte público da região da Filadélfia
hotspots.example: We used SEPTA to get from Center City to the museum.

hotspots.translation: pretzel macio, vendido como lanche
hotspots.example: I grabbed a warm soft pretzel from a street cart.

mission.title: Order a Local Sandwich
mission.description: Você está em uma lanchonete da Filadélfia e quer pedir um hoagie com uma pequena alteração.

steps.npcLine: What can I get for you?

options.text: I'll have an Italian hoagie, please, with no onions.
options.feedback: Perfeito! 'I'll have...' é uma forma natural de pedir, e 'with no onions' deixa clara a alteração.

options.text: Give me one hoagie Italian and remove the onions.
options.feedback: A frase pode soar direta demais. Use 'I'll have...' para pedir e 'with no onions' para indicar a preferência.

touristGuide.title: Pioneer Courthouse Square
touristGuide.text: Known as Portland's living room, Pioneer Courthouse Square is a popular gathering place in the city center. From here, visitors can explore downtown shops, ride the MAX light rail, or walk toward the Willamette River.

hotspots.translation: conjunto de barracas de comida reunidas em um espaço
hotspots.example: Let's meet at the food cart pod and choose lunch there.

hotspots.translation: jaqueta leve impermeável
hotspots.example: I keep a rain shell in my backpack for walks around Portland.

hotspots.translation: linha do trem leve de Portland
hotspots.example: The MAX line is a convenient way to cross downtown.

mission.title: Choose Lunch at a Food Cart Pod
mission.description: Você chegou a um espaço com várias barracas e quer descobrir quais opções vegetarianas estão disponíveis.

steps.npcLine: Hi! What are you in the mood for today?

options.text: I'm looking for something vegetarian. What do you recommend?
options.feedback: Muito bem! 'I'm looking for...' explica o que você procura, e 'What do you recommend?' pede uma sugestão com educação.

options.text: I want eat without meat. What you have?
options.feedback: Diga 'I want to eat...' ou, de forma mais natural, 'I'm looking for something vegetarian.' Em perguntas, use 'What do you have?'

touristGuide.title: Temple Square
touristGuide.text: Temple Square is a historic and cultural landmark in downtown Salt Lake City. Nearby streets offer museums, gardens, and shops, while the Wasatch Mountains rise to the east of the city.

hotspots.translation: cordilheira que acompanha o leste de Salt Lake City
hotspots.example: The Wasatch Mountains are visible from many parts of the city.

hotspots.translation: dia de esqui com neve fresca e fofa
hotspots.example: The fresh snowfall made it a perfect powder day in the mountains.

hotspots.translation: início de uma trilha
hotspots.example: The shuttle drops hikers off near the trailhead.

mission.title: Ask About a Mountain Shuttle
mission.description: Você quer fazer uma trilha perto de Salt Lake City e precisa confirmar o ponto de embarque do transporte.

steps.npcLine: Are you planning to hike in the Wasatch this morning?

options.text: Yes. Where can I catch the shuttle to the trailhead?
options.feedback: Ótimo! 'Where can I catch the shuttle...?' pergunta naturalmente onde embarcar no transporte.

options.text: Yes, where I take the shuttle for start the trail?
options.feedback: Use a estrutura 'Where can I catch...?' e diga 'to the trailhead' para indicar o destino.

route3D.name: Campus Martius to the Guardian Building

touristGuide.title: Campus Martius Park
touristGuide.text: Campus Martius Park is a lively public square in the center of downtown Detroit. It is surrounded by historic buildings, restaurants, and places to relax, and it hosts events throughout the year.

hotspots.translation: cachorro-quente coberto com chili, cebola e mostarda
hotspots.example: A classic Detroit Coney dog comes topped with chili, onions, and mustard.

hotspots.translation: apelido da via M-10 em Detroit
hotspots.example: Traffic on the Lodge can be busy during the evening commute.

hotspots.translation: movimento musical e gravadora surgidos em Detroit
hotspots.example: The Motown Museum tells the story of Detroit's influential music scene.

mission.title: Order a Detroit Coney Dog
mission.description: Em uma lanchonete de Detroit, peça um Coney dog e pergunte se pode retirar um ingrediente.

steps.npcLine: Would you like everything on your Coney dog?

options.text: Yes, please, but could I have it without onions?
options.feedback: Muito bem! 'Could I have it without...?' é uma forma educada e clara de pedir para retirar um ingrediente.

options.text: Yes, but take out from it the onions.
options.feedback: Para pedir a retirada de um ingrediente, diga 'without onions' ou 'Could you leave off the onions?'

route3D.name: Mill City Museum to the Stone Arch Bridge

touristGuide.title: Mill City and the Riverfront
touristGuide.text: The Mississippi Riverfront in Minneapolis combines the city's milling history with scenic paths and views of the Stone Arch Bridge. In winter, enclosed downtown skyways give pedestrians a warm route between many buildings.

hotspots.translation: passarela fechada que conecta prédios no centro
hotspots.example: We used the skyway to walk between downtown buildings on a cold day.

hotspots.translation: cabana de temporada junto a um lago
hotspots.example: Her family spends a week at their lake cabin every summer.

hotspots.translation: despedida demorada, com várias conversas antes de ir embora
hotspots.example: We had a Minnesota goodbye that lasted almost half an hour.

mission.title: Find a Warm Route Downtown
mission.description: Em um dia muito frio, pergunte como chegar a outro prédio usando as passarelas internas do centro.

steps.npcLine: Are you trying to get across downtown without going outside?

options.text: Yes. Can I use the skyway to get to that building?
options.feedback: Perfeito! Em Minneapolis, 'the skyway' é uma rede de passarelas internas que conecta muitos prédios do centro.

options.text: Yes, I can go by the sky road inside?
options.feedback: O termo usado é 'skyway'. Pergunte 'Can I use the skyway to get to...?' para confirmar o trajeto.
